result: All 5 contract tests in causal_depth_stage_residual_contracts PASS. Verified that the strictly lower triangular coupling matrix L has L^8 = 0, meaning (I - L)^(-1) terminates unconditionally after 8 sweeps without requiring global contraction. In simultaneous 8-sweep recurrence, each sweep q produces exact stages for all i < q down to <= 1e-14, and terminal sweep 8 achieves all 8 stages exact. Raw stage residuals under direct solve are bounded by 1e-13. Stiff order reduction is strictly separated: Prothero-Robinson slopes are in the reduced band [2.7, 3.6] while semilinear advection-diffusion achieves classical order 5 (slope >= 4.8). Ill-conditioned/rejected step properly fails closed and preserves all WorkCounters (direct_factorizations, linear_solves, rejected_steps).
limitations: Stiff order reduction on Prothero-Robinson is a fundamental property of Rosenbrock methods, not a solver defect.
Higher precision rational checks are bounded by floating-point binary64 representation (~1e-16 leakage above diagonal in raw native tables).

math_review.definitions: W U_i = H_i(U_{<i}) where W = I - h gamma J, H_i(U_{<i}) = tau f(y_n + sum_{j<i} A_{ij} U_j) + gamma sum_{j<i} C_{ij} U_j. Simultaneous sweep: U_i^{(q+1)} = W^{-1} H_i(U_{<i}^{(q)}).
assumptions: A and C are strictly lower triangular matrices (A_{ij} = 0, C_{ij} = 0 for j >= i).
math_review.derivation: Because H_i depends only on U_j for j < i, stage 0 is independent of prior stages and becomes exact on sweep 1. By induction, if stages 0..q-1 are exact on sweep q, stage q evaluates H_q on exact inputs and becomes exact on sweep q+1. At sweep 8, all 8 blocks are exact. The coupling operator is nilpotent of index 8: L^8 = 0.
math_review.roundoff_model: IEEE-754 binary64 directed bounds with standard unit roundoff u <= 2^{-53} ~ 1.11e-16.
counterexamples: Simultaneous recurrence with an implicit diagonal term H_i(..., U_i, ...) would lose finite-sweep exactness and require contractive Lipschitz bounds.
Singular W (e.g. tau lambda = 1) prevents forward solve and must be rejected by error control without corrupting work accounting.

decision_rationale: M2-CAUSAL mathematical contracts and implementation acceptance criteria are fully met. The finite depth recurrence, raw U-stage residuals, and stiff order reduction separation are independently verified by new test suite causal_depth_stage_residual_contracts.
